reconstruction.crossValidation: EAF65B51 (2:05) and 3DD9483F (2:07) show the same Bm7->E7->Am7->Am7/D boundary sequence; reconstructed boundary times agree within 0.1s.
reconstruction.method: The play screen's chord strip is a scrolling lane whose left orange bar is the playhead (screenshot time, 1s display resolution). Uniform thin gridlines inside the strip measure 80.5-84.8 px apart per screenshot and are interpreted as 1-second ticks, giving a per-screenshot px/sec scale. A chord label's left edge is its segment start; boundary time = t_now + (x_label - x_playhead) / scale.
reconstruction.segmentLengths: all observed segments are approx. 1.9-2.1s long (not aligned to the 1.6667s bar length)
reconstruction.uncertainty: each boundary is an estimate with approx. ±0.3s uncertainty (1s time-display resolution, gridline interpretation, label placement). Segments extending beyond the strip are open-ended.
